title: A small start for family activity
titleZh: 一家人一起动起来，从小小一步开始
summaryZh: 一项家庭活动宣传鼓励家长和孩子一起尝试，不必先成为运动高手。

sentences.text: On 8 October 2026, the British government announced a new part of its Let’s Move! campaign.
sentences.zh: 2026年10月8日，英国政府宣布了“Let’s Move!”宣传活动的新阶段。

sentences.text: The New Moves Club encourages families with children aged seven to eleven to try an activity together.
sentences.zh: “New Moves Club”鼓励有七至十一岁孩子的家庭一起尝试一项活动。

sentences.text: The message is simple: you do not need to be good at a sport before you join in.
sentences.zh: 它传达的信息很简单：不必先擅长某项运动，才可以参与。

sentences.text: Some parents worry that they are not sporty enough, and this can stop them from trying.
sentences.zh: 一些家长担心自己不够擅长运动，这种顾虑可能阻止他们尝试。

sentences.text: A survey asked 2,006 parents and guardians of seven-to-eleven-year-olds in England about being active.
sentences.zh: 一项调查询问了英格兰2,006名七至十一岁儿童的家长和监护人有关活动的情况。

sentences.text: It took place in August, before the October campaign announcement.
sentences.zh: 调查在八月进行，早于十月的宣传活动公告。

sentences.text: In that survey, 82 percent wanted their family to be more active together.
sentences.zh: 该调查中，82%的受访者希望家人一起进行更多活动。

sentences.text: Forty percent said a lack of time stopped them from taking part with their children.
sentences.zh: 40%的受访者表示，时间不足阻碍了自己与孩子一起参与活动。

sentences.text: The campaign therefore suggests short periods of movement that can take just ten minutes.
sentences.zh: 因此，这项宣传活动建议安排短时间的身体活动，有些只需要十分钟。

sentences.text: These short periods are a way to start and build up activity, not the whole daily goal.
sentences.zh: 这些短时间的活动是开始并逐渐增加活动量的方式，而不是全天的完整目标。

sentences.text: The campaign focuses on joining in, trying something new and enjoying time together.
sentences.zh: 这项活动关注的是参与、尝试新事物以及享受一起度过的时间。

words.note: encourages作单数主语The New Moves Club的谓语，encourage somebody to do表示鼓励某人做某事。
worry that引出所担心的内容；此处不是承诺或确认。
parents and guardians并列，guardians是复数，指承担监护责任的人。
a lack of time是时间不足；a后用名词lack。
focuses on后并列joining、trying、enjoying，表示享受相处时间。

phrases.note: join in强调加入正在进行的活动。
take part in后接活动；这里with their children说明和谁一起。

sentences.note: not连接对比：短时间活动是起点，而非全天目标；a way to do表示做某事的一种方式。

questions.text: What small activity could a family try together?
questions.zh: 一家人可以一起尝试什么小活动？

expressions.text: We could start with ten minutes of…
expressions.note: with后可接名词或动名词，例如walking；这是可复用教学表达。
